item.description:
### Added - **Private Access (ZPA):** a new module that publishes private applications through ZPA. It creates an App Connector Group and its provisioning key, a segment group, a server group and an application segment per app, then access, timeout, AppProtection inspection and browser isolation policies, with an optional Browser Access app and Privileged Remote Access (RDP, SSH) consoles. - **ZPA templates:** one wildcard segment for the internal domain, or the common apps (Active Directory, file shares, intranet, a jump host) with Healthcare, Financial services or Education apps. Applications can also be imported from, and saved to, a CSV. - **ZPA dry run, Apply and Undo:** the dry run reads the tenant and shows what Apply creates; objects already there are used as they are, and a destination already in another segment on the same ports is caught. Apply shows the provisioning key once and never saves it. Undo deletes what the run created. **Manage** lists and deletes the objects named with the prefix.
### Changed - **Policy Simulator:** when the ZPA customer ID isn't in the API token, it's also looked up in Client Connector's company information.
